**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

- The document's only MFN-style clause is § 7.6 (p0031), which runs **in Customer's favour** — Vendor warrants its Fees to us will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers for comparable volumes and terms. Per the rule's detection guidance, a Vendor-granted MFN is marked compliant and not redlined.
- I checked the planner's candidate sections (§ 7 Fees, § 4 Order Forms, § 30 General) in full and ran document-wide searches for "most favoured/favored nation", "best pricing", "no less favourable", matching/right-of-first-refusal, benchmarking, and preferred-supplier language. No provision obliges Customer to extend Vendor terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers.
- Preferred element "Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor" is therefore already met; no redline proposed.
